scope: Minimal practical public-source reference annotation contract; static docs/code audit. No existing current223/V112 dataset or new training/inference.

definitions.name: ORIGINAL_NATIVE
definitions.reference: Virtual cuboid camera-facing0..7, centroid8 excluded. Front selected by outward-normal camera alignment among four vertical faces; image-left/right from frontTOP, rear by corresponding depth edge. Historical area-V4 is a different rule, not an alternative selected by q accuracy.
definitions.surface_requirement: Exact mesh/surface coincidence is not universal. A virtual reference, expected structure supporting its semantic interpretation, and the actual first visible surface/pixel must be recorded separately.
definitions.original_synthetic_target: Legacy9ray external fraction is a proxy, not proof of physical surface or human semantic D/E. v61 central M4 pixel presence is also a different target.

definitions.name: SEMANTIC_VISIBILITY
definitions.reference: Meaning of the registered native reference/corner is directly visible D, blocked by an identified external object E, self hidden S, or unresolved U. Coordinate quality, pixel ownership and crop availability remain separate.
definitions.limit: The original direct/external human task does not impose V127 all37-ray/full-region criteria. Borderline/partial semantics require actual review and explicit evidence, not a new universal mathematical replacement.

definitions.name: V127_CONSTRUCTED_CERTIFICATE
definitions.reference: make_mesh explicitly makes all8 canonical anchors literal named-part vertices, with37 endpoint/edge/face witnesses; region_teacher uses ≥2 facing faces plus all active target-direct witnesses for D; all previously-D active witnesses foreign-first for E; partial/ties/misses U.
definitions.scope: Only two new constructed board/block and rib/leg geometries. Exact surface coincidence and this conservative region rule are local source construction certificates, not original arbitrary real/legacy native semantics.

definitions.name: V136_CONTINUOUS_EXTENSION
definitions.reference: Positive scaling applies to vertices, anchors, patches, edges and witnesses together; every anchor remains on its designated part. Normal-facing role equivalence is certified independently of q. Teacher stayscontinuous, raster ownershipdiagnostic doesnotrelabel.
definitions.scope: Same two topologies and constructed reference/support coincidence; widening height/camera/material does not remove this limitation.

annotation_unit: One source frame + one official/visually resolved target entity + all8 native-role records. Keep all official candidate instances; an entity choice must be explained, not made by largest box or nearest q.
required_separations: target identity and official ID namespace
original dynamic role0..7 and front-face evidence/competing role hypotheses
virtual reference XY or bounded/unknown coordinate evidence
actual surface membership/ownership as separate observation
original initializer q/L/availability association only after reference/role review

direct_rules.D: Allow a conservative D proposal when target and original native role are identified and positive RGB/pair/source evidence shows that registered-reference meaning. Do not require the virtualpoint itself to contain target material.
direct_rules.E: Require positive identified foreign blocking of the registered reference plus evidence it would be self-visible without that foreign object. SAM0, depth disagreement, missing support or wrong predicted q alone cannot give E.
direct_rules.S: Require explicit self-occlusion semantic evidence. Convex/mask/depth proxies are stored separately; proxy-only evidence remains semanticU.
direct_rules.U: Record a concrete unknown reason: target/role ambiguity, original normal-face unresolved, reference/support interpretation unknown, unbounded coordinate if needed for the decision, mixed/partial state, foreign/self cause unclear, truncation/lowresolution, unsupported projectionalignment, or not yet reviewed.
direct_rules.coordinate_uncertainty: Keep xy estimate+radius/rect/polygon or null; no fabricated subpixel precision. Uncertain coordinate does not automaticallyerase a defensible semanticlabel. Future compositing needs bounded reference/support, separately from semanticlabel.
direct_rules.LOCO: No supplied pose: only certify dynamic roles if the original normal-face convention is uniquely identifiable from image/structure evidence. Do not replace it with projected-area/longest-face/fork-pocket/nearest-query heuristics. Otherwise preserve role hypotheses andU; do notdeclare native annotation globally impossible.
direct_rules.Pallox: Suppliedpose/K/declaredobjectaxes may project virtualreferences withoutPnP. Verify axes/extents/role separately. RGB-depth alignment, SAM masks, frame visibility andmesh ownership areconditionalproxies, not semanticgold.

workflow_checklist_KO: 완료된 source intake/selection과 원본 RGB hash·ID namespace·기존 capture fold를 확인한다. 현 실사 평가셋·모델 점수·예측 q는 보지 않는다.
원본 full RGB와 공식 bbox만 보고 대상 후보들을 보존한다. 명확한 대상이면 annotationID와 증거를 기록하고, 불명확하면 targetU로 남긴다.
원래 virtual cuboid의 near/far/top/bottom 역할이 무엇인지 먼저 기록한다. normal-face 역할이 둘 이상 가능하면 후보와 이유를 남긴다. bbox모서리나보기좋은물리cue를native로대체하지않는다.
virtual reference의 좌표·불확실성과 그 의미를 보여주는 구조 지지를 따로 기록한다. 실제 표면 일치 여부는 별도 필드이며 D의 보편적인 필수 조건이 아니다.
명확한 상태에는 실제로 본 부분·가린 물체·자기가림 근거를 적어 D/E/S를 제안한다. 판단 근거가 부족한 점은 이유가 있는 U로 남긴다. 모든8slot을보존한다.
assistant 제안과 독립 assistant 검토도 human_gold=false다. 증거 tier와 reviewer를 명시하고, 사람 주석이라고 부르지 않는다.
그 후 필요한 경우 원래 initializer q/L의 연결·좌표오차·crop지원 여부를 별도진단한다. GT근접으로slot/target/permutation을고르거나GT중심crop을만들지않는다.
이번 단계는 실제 annotation 수율·불확실성의 검토다. 새 forward·합성cover·학습·threshold·실사선택을실행하지않는다.
metadata_validator_limit: Logical gates only; passing JSON cannot certify actual pixels, correct virtual-role interpretation or human gold. Actual viewing/adjudication is necessary.
